senses.title: Relating to how it runs
senses.titleCN: 运行上的：与机器怎么转有关
senses.definition: relating to the working of a machine, system, or process
senses.definitionCN: 与机器、系统或流程如何运转有关
senses.example: The engineers separated design problems from operational problems.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师把设计问题与运行问题分开处理。
senses.why: The suffix -al points to a domain: what happens while the thing is running, as distinct from how it was designed.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -al 指向一个领域：事物运转时发生的事，与它如何被设计区分开来。

senses.title: Ready to be used
senses.titleCN: 可投入使用：不是图纸，是能跑的
senses.definition: in a state of being able to work or be used as intended
senses.definitionCN: 处于能够按预期工作或使用的状态
senses.example: The new control tower is operational after two years of testing.
senses.exampleCN: 新控制塔经过两年测试后已可投入使用。
senses.why: Here the word answers a readiness question: the thing is not merely complete on paper, it can actually perform its function.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词回答的是“就绪”问题：事物不只在纸面上完成，它真能履行职责。

senses.title: The cost of keeping it running
senses.titleCN: 运营成本：让它每天转起来的钱
senses.definition: describing the expenses of running an organization or facility rather than building it
senses.definitionCN: 指维持组织或设施日常运转的开支，而非建设开支
senses.example: Operational costs rose with fuel and staff wages.
senses.exampleCN: 运营成本随燃料与员工工资上涨。
senses.why: Budgets split capital from operation: one pays to build, the other pays to keep the thing alive each day.
senses.whyCN: 预算把资本支出与运营支出分开：一笔付建设，另一笔付让它每天活下去。

senses.title: Defined by what you do
senses.titleCN: 操作定义：用做法代替概念
senses.definition: describing a definition that specifies the procedures or measurements used to identify something
senses.definitionCN: 指用识别某事物所需的具体程序或测量来下定义
senses.example: The study operationalised 'stress' as a rise in heart rate during the task.
senses.exampleCN: 该研究把“压力”操作化为任务期间心率上升。
senses.why: Some ideas cannot be seen directly, so science defines them by the operations that produce them, making the concept testable.
senses.whyCN: 有些概念无法直接看见，科学便用产生它的操作来定义，使概念可被检验。

senses.title: The mathematics of decisions
senses.titleCN: 运筹：把调度问题算清楚
senses.definition: describing the use of mathematical methods to improve the planning and running of complex activities
senses.definitionCN: 指用数学方法改进复杂活动的计划与运行
senses.example: Operational research cut the average waiting time at the depot.
senses.exampleCN: 运筹研究缩短了车站的平均等待时间。
senses.why: When an organization runs, its choices can be modelled; operational research treats scheduling as a problem with a best answer.
senses.whyCN: 组织一旦运转，其选择就可以建模型；运筹研究把调度当作一个有最优解的问题。

senses.title: At the level of action
senses.titleCN: 作战层面：战略之下、战术之上
senses.definition: describing the level of military activity concerned with planning and conducting campaigns
senses.definitionCN: 指军事活动中负责筹划与实施战役的层级
senses.example: Operational command decided where the units would meet before the battle.
senses.exampleCN: 作战指挥决定各部队在战斗前于何处会合。
senses.why: Military theory separates strategy (why to fight), operations (where and when to move), and tactics (how to fight the next hour).
senses.whyCN: 军事理论把战略（为何打）、作战（何时何地调动）与战术（接下来一小时怎么打）分开。

senses.title: Risk from daily running
senses.titleCN: 运营风险：不是市场，而是流程出错
senses.definition: describing the risk of loss from failed processes, people, systems, or external events
senses.definitionCN: 指因流程、人员、系统失效或外部事件造成损失的风险
senses.example: The bank holds capital against operational risk as well as credit risk.
senses.exampleCN: 银行不仅为信用风险，也为运营风险持有资本。
senses.why: Finance distinguishes risk from markets and borrowers from risk that arises simply because an organization must run every day.
senses.whyCN: 金融业把市场与借款人的风险，同“组织每天必须运转”本身带来的风险区分开。

senses.title: A circuit that computes
senses.titleCN: 运算放大器：让电路做算术
senses.definition: describing an amplifier designed to perform mathematical operations on signals
senses.definitionCN: 指为对信号执行数学运算而设计的放大器
senses.example: The operational amplifier summed the two sensor voltages.
senses.exampleCN: 运算放大器把两个传感器的电压相加。
senses.why: Early analogue computers used amplifiers to add and integrate; the name stayed even after the circuits became general-purpose components.
senses.whyCN: 早期模拟计算机用放大器做加法与积分；即使这些电路后来成了通用元件，名字仍保留下来。

intro.en: Operational is operation plus -al. Operation comes from Latin operatio, a working, from operari, to work, and opus, work.
intro.cn: operational 是 operation 加 -al。operation 来自拉丁语 operatio“劳作”，出自 operari“工作”与 opus“工作、作品”。

items.en: Opus meant work, a task, or a product of work. It survives in magnum opus and in the musical term opera.
items.cn: opus 意为工作、任务或劳动成果。它留在 magnum opus 与音乐术语 opera 中。

items.en: The verb meant to work, to labour, and to perform a task. It could describe both physical labour and the working of a power.
items.cn: 该动词意为工作、劳作、执行任务，既可描述体力劳动，也可描述某种力量的作用。

items.en: The noun named a working or an effect produced. Medieval Latin also used it for mathematical and medical procedures.
items.cn: 该名词指劳作或产生的效果。中世纪拉丁语也用它指数学与医学操作。

items.en: French operation covered work, a surgical procedure, and a military action. English borrowed all three.
items.cn: 法语 operation 涵盖工作、外科手术与军事行动；英语把这三层都借了进来。

items.en: Operational first meant 'of an operation' in surgery and mathematics, then extended to machines and organizations in the industrial age.
items.cn: operational 最初指外科与数学意义上的“操作的”， industrial 时代扩展到机器与组织。

items.en: The 20th century added operational research, operational definition, operational risk, and the operational amplifier.
items.cn: 20 世纪增加了运筹研究、操作定义、运营风险与运算放大器等用法。

note.en: The first group is the operate family; the second compares adjectives that describe readiness, function, and practical work.
note.cn: 第一组是 operate 词族；第二组比较表示就绪、功能与实际运作的形容词。

entries.definition: to work or control a machine, to run a business, or to perform surgery.
entries.definitionCN: 操作或控制机器、经营业务，或施行手术。

entries.definition: the act of working, a surgical procedure, or a military action.
entries.definitionCN: 工作行为、外科手术，或军事行动。

entries.definition: a person who runs a machine, or a company that runs a service.
entries.definitionCN: 操作机器的人，或经营某项服务的公司。

entries.definition: working as designed. It stresses purpose served, while operational can also stress the running process or its cost.
entries.definitionCN: 按设计正常工作；强调所服务的目的，而 operational 也可强调运行过程或成本。

entries.definition: useful in real situations rather than theoretical. It judges usefulness, not running status.
entries.definitionCN: 在真实情境中有用而非理论的；判断的是用处，不是运行状态。

entries.definition: in action or in effect. A system can be active without being fully operational.
entries.definitionCN: 正在行动或生效的；系统可以处于活动状态却尚未完全可运行。

entries.definition: relating to long-term aims. In military theory it is the level above operational.
entries.definitionCN: 与长期目标有关；在军事理论中位于“作战”之上。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: opus, work, plus operari, to work, then -ation and -al. Operational means 'of the working'.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：opus“工作”，加 operari“工作”，再加 -ation 与 -al。operational 就是“属于运转的”。

normal.en: Opus is work; operational is the adjective of work being done right now.
normal.cn: opus 是工作；operational 是“工作正在进行”的形容词。

normal.en: Design is the drawing; operational is the machine actually turning.
normal.cn: 设计是图纸；operational 是机器真的在转。

normal.en: Operational costs are the money paid every day, not the money paid to build.
normal.cn: 运营成本是每天都要付的钱，不是建造时付的钱。

normal.en: An operational definition says what you do, not what you mean.
normal.cn: 操作定义说的是你怎么做，而不是你指什么。

normal.en: All green lights mean the system is operational.
normal.cn: 指示灯全绿，就表示系统处于可运行状态。

abstract.en: 'Operational' is where plans meet friction: everything works on paper, and only some things work at three in the morning.
abstract.cn: operational 是计划撞上摩擦的地方：纸面上一切都能行，凌晨三点只有一部分真能行。

abstract.en: An operational definition trades depth for testability, and the trade is usually worth making.
abstract.cn: 操作定义用深度换可检验性，这笔交易通常值得。

abstract.en: The word hides the labour inside the system; what looks automatic is a schedule of people and maintenance.
abstract.cn: 这个词把系统里的劳动藏了起来；看似自动的东西，其实是一张排班表与维护表。

examples.en: The plant became fully operational only after the cooling system passed its safety test.
examples.cn: 冷却系统通过安全测试后，这座工厂才全面投入运行。

examples.en: Operational costs, not construction costs, decide whether the railway survives.
examples.cn: 决定这条铁路能否存续的是运营成本，而不是建设成本。

examples.en: The team agreed on an operational definition of 'success' before collecting any data.
examples.cn: 团队在收集数据之前先就“成功”的操作定义达成一致。

dict_mnemonic.text: operate（运行）+ ional（的）——能跑起来、正在运转的，都是 operational。

root: 由 operation（运行、操作，源自拉丁语 operatio“劳作”）加 -al 构成；词基为拉丁语 opus“工作”与 operari“工作”，故本义为“与运转、操作有关的”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of operational, all concerned with work being done. The work may be a machine turning, a system ready to run, the cost of daily upkeep, a procedure that defines a concept, a mathematical plan, a military campaign, a process failure, or an analogue computation.
sensesIntro.cn: operational 的八个义项都与“正在做的工作”有关。这工作可以是机器转动、系统就绪、日常维护成本、定义概念的程序、数学调度、军事战役、流程失效，或模拟电路运算。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a production line running with every indicator green and nobody waiting for a repair.
core.cn: 核心意象：生产线正在运转，指示灯全绿，没有人等着维修。

branches.en: RUNNING AND READY: the process of working, and the state of being fit to work.
branches.cn: 运转与就绪：工作的过程，以及能够工作的状态。

branches.en: THE PRICE OF RUNNING: daily costs and the risks that arise from ordinary processes.
branches.cn: 运转的代价：日常成本，以及普通流程带来的风险。

branches.en: DEFINITION BY PROCEDURE: a concept replaced by the operations that measure it.
branches.cn: 以程序定义：用测量它的操作取代概念本身。

branches.cn: 筹划行动：数学调度，以及位于战略与战术之间的军事层级。

branches.en: COMPUTING BY CIRCUIT: an amplifier named for the operations it performs.
branches.cn: 用电路运算：因执行运算而得名的放大器。

intro.en: Operational is operation plus -al. The family runs through operate, operator, and operation, with opus as the Latin base.
intro.cn: operational 是 operation 加 -al。词族包括 operate、operator、operation，拉丁词基为 opus。

latinIntro.en: The base is opus, work, and its verb operari. Latin operatio names the working or the effect produced.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 opus“工作”及其动词 operari。拉丁语 operatio 指劳作或产生的效果。

items.meaning: to work, control, or carry out an activity
items.example: Only trained staff may operate the crane.
items.exampleCN: 只有受过训练的员工可以操作这台起重机。

items.meaning: the act of working, or a planned action
items.meaningCN: 工作行为，或计划好的行动
items.example: The operation runs from six in the morning.
items.exampleCN: 这项作业从早晨六点开始运行。

items.meaning: relating to running, or ready to run
items.meaningCN: 与运行有关的，或已可运行的
items.example: The system is operational but not yet open to the public.
items.exampleCN: 系统已可运行，但尚未向公众开放。

items.meaning: from the point of view of running
items.example: Operationally, the two designs are almost the same.
items.exampleCN: 从运行角度看，两种设计几乎一样。

items.meaning: a person or firm that runs something
items.meaningCN: 操作者，或经营某项业务的公司
items.example: The operator stopped the line for a safety check.
items.exampleCN: 操作员为安全检查停下了生产线。

items.meaning: to work together toward a shared aim
items.meaningCN: 为共同目标一起工作；合作
items.example: The two labs cooperated on the trial.
items.exampleCN: 两个实验室在该试验上合作。

items.meaning: in effect or ready to act; also a surgical adjective
items.meaningCN: 生效的、可行动的；也用于外科语境
items.example: The new rule is operative from January.

items.meaning: a work, especially a large artistic or musical work
items.meaningCN: 作品，尤指大型艺术或音乐作品
items.example: The symphony became his best-known opus.
items.exampleCN: 这部交响曲成了他最著名的作品。

items.meaning: able to be operated or used
items.example: The hatch is operable from inside.
items.exampleCN: 这个舱门可从内部操作。

definition_zh: 操作员；接线员；运算符；经营者
definition_en: a person who works a machine, a telephone switchboard or a service, or a symbol that stands for an operation in mathematics and computing
core_image: 控制台前一个人戴着耳机，把一排闪烁的推子逐个扶正
scene: 演播室外的控制台上，一个戴耳机的年轻人盯着指示灯，把每一路声音逐一推稳。The operator kept every channel balanced during the live broadcast.
sceneCN: 这里是「操作员」（第 1 个义项：负责操纵设备的人）；句意为直播时那位操作员让每个声道都保持平衡。图中可辨识物件：调音台推子、指示灯、耳机。

pos.zh: 操作员；接线员；运算符；经营者

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语过去分词词干加 -tion 构成，义为「操作；手术；运算」
由拉丁语 operatus 进入英语，义为「运转；操作；经营」

senses.title: A person who works equipment
senses.definition: someone who controls a machine, a vehicle or a piece of equipment as their job
senses.definitionCN: 以操纵机器、车辆或设备为职业的人
senses.example: The crane operator stopped the load when the wind rose.
senses.exampleCN: 风变大时，起重机操作员停下了吊运的货物。
senses.why: Latin operator means one who works, and English narrowed that to a person whose work is running a particular machine.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 operator 意为「干活的人」，英语把范围收窄成「专管某一台机器的人」。

senses.title: A person on a telephone switchboard
senses.definition: someone who connects telephone calls in an office, a hotel or an exchange
senses.definitionCN: 在办公室、旅馆或交换台为用户接通电话的人
senses.example: The operator put me through to the manager.
senses.exampleCN: 接线员帮我把电话接到了经理那里。
senses.why: Early exchanges were manual, so connecting calls was real work done by hand, and the general word for a worker became the job title.
senses.whyCN: 早期电话交换全靠人工，接电话线是真用手做的活，于是「干活的人」这个泛称就成了岗位名称。

senses.title: A mathematical or logical symbol
senses.definition: a symbol that stands for an operation, such as plus, minus or AND in a program
senses.definitionCN: 表示一种运算的符号，如加号、减号，或程序中的逻辑与
senses.example: In this expression, the plus sign is an operator.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个表达式里，加号就是一个运算符。
senses.why: In mathematics and computing an operation is a defined action on values, and the mark that triggers it takes the name of the one who performs work.
senses.whyCN: 在数学与计算里，运算是对数值执行一种规定的动作，而触发这个动作的记号，就借用了「干活者」的名字。

senses.title: A company that runs a service
senses.definition: a business that runs a service such as transport, tours or a network
senses.definitionCN: 经营运输、旅游或网络等服务的公司
senses.example: The bus operator added two night routes this year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公交运营公司今年新增了两条夜班线路。
senses.why: A company that keeps a service running is, in the word's older sense, the one doing the work, so it too is called an operator.
senses.whyCN: 让一项服务持续运转的公司，按这个词的本义就是「干活的那一方」，所以它也被称作 operator。

intro.en: Operator is the Latin agent noun for a worker, taken into English with its meaning almost unchanged and then narrowed to particular jobs.
intro.cn: operator 是拉丁语里表示「干活者」的施事名词，进入英语时意思几乎没变，后来才收窄到各个具体岗位。

items.en: Operari meant to work or to have an effect, and it supplied the verb at the centre of this family.
items.cn: operari 意为干活或起作用，是这个词族的核心动词。

items.en: Operator was the agent noun: the one who works, a maker or a doer.
items.cn: operator 是施事名词：干活的人、制作者、行动者。

items.en: English adopted operator for a person who performs work, especially skilled or technical work.
items.cn: 英语借入 operator，指从事工作的人，尤指有技术含量的工作。

items.en: With the telegraph and the telephone, operator became the title of the person who connected lines by hand.
items.cn: 随着电报与电话出现，operator 成了手工接线者的岗位名称。

items.en: Modern English extends it to machine drivers, service companies and the symbols that trigger operations in mathematics.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到机器操作者、服务公司，以及数学中触发运算的符号。

note.en: The look-alike group is the Latin work family that operator belongs to; the near-meaning group is other words for people who run or tend equipment.
note.cn: 形近组是 operator 所属、由拉丁语「干活」长出的词族；近义组是其他表示看管或摆弄设备的人的词。

entries.definition: To work, to control a machine or to perform surgery.
entries.definitionCN: 运转；操作机器；动手术。

entries.definition: The act of working, or a medical procedure.
entries.definitionCN: 运作的行为，或医疗手术。

entries.definition: Relating to how something works in practice.
entries.definitionCN: 与实际运作有关的。

entries.definition: Working, in force, or a person doing secret work.
entries.definitionCN: 起作用的、实施中的，或从事秘密工作的人。

entries.definition: A person trained to look after technical equipment.
entries.definitionCN: 受过训练、负责技术设备的人。

entries.definition: A person who repairs and adjusts machines.
entries.definitionCN: 修理和调校机器的人。

entries.definition: A person or device that directs how something runs.
entries.definitionCN: 指挥某事物如何运转的人或装置。

normalIntro.en: Operator is the person-shaped member of the Latin work family, so the mnemonics follow -or, the suffix that turns work into a worker.
normalIntro.cn: operator 是拉丁语「干活」词族中「人」的那一格，联想就沿着 -or 走：这个后缀把「活」变成「干活的人」。

normal.en: Operator is operari plus -or, the doer of the work.
normal.cn: operator 是 operari 加 -or，就是「干活的那个人」。

normal.en: Operation is the work itself, so operator and operation are the doer and the deed.
normal.cn: operation 是「活」本身，operator 与 operation 正好是做事的人与所做的事。

normal.en: A telephone operator works the switchboard by hand, which is why the title survived the machines.
normal.cn: 电话接线员靠手在交换台上干活，所以这个称呼在机器时代还留了下来。

normal.en: In a program, the operator is the sign that performs the operation.
normal.cn: 在程序里，operator 就是执行那个运算的符号。

normal.en: A tour operator runs the trips, so a company, not only a person, can carry the name.
normal.cn: tour operator 负责组织行程，所以不只是人，公司也能叫这个名字。

abstract.en: One person at a console holding many channels steady: work made visible as a pair of hands.
abstract.cn: 一个人守在控制台，把许多声道扶稳：活就这样变成看得见的一双手。

abstract.en: The word for a doer quietly became a job title, then a symbol on a page.
abstract.cn: 「干活者」这个说法悄悄变成岗位名，又变成纸上的一个符号。

abstract.en: Every machine that runs well has someone, somewhere, who knows its sounds.
abstract.cn: 每台转得顺的机器背后，总有个在某个角落听懂它声音的人。

examples.en: The operator kept every channel balanced during the live broadcast.
examples.cn: 直播时那位操作员让每个声道都保持平衡。

examples.en: The operator put me through to the manager.
examples.cn: 接线员帮我把电话接到了经理那里。

examples.en: The bus operator added two night routes this year.
examples.cn: 这家公交运营公司今年新增了两条夜班线路。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哦，跑瑞特儿」——坐在机器旁不停按按钮的那个人；记住 operator 是操作员。

root: 拉丁语 operari（干活）的施事名词 operator（干活的人）直接进入英语；同族词有 operate、operation、operational。opera 虽与它共享更远的拉丁词根，却指「歌剧」，来源路线不同。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a person who works; the senses split into equipment, telephone lines, symbols in an expression, and companies that run a service.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「干活的人」；义项随后分成看管设备、守电话线、表达式里的符号，以及经营服务的公司。

core.cn: 核心意象：一个人戴着耳机守在控制台，把一排闪烁的推子逐个扶正。

branches.en: a crane driver watching a load swing in the wind
branches.cn: 吊车司机盯着风里晃动的货物

branches.en: hands resting on a console during a quiet shift
branches.cn: 安静的班上，双手搭在控制台上

branches.en: a voice saying which line is calling
branches.cn: 一个报出哪条线来电的声音

branches.en: a plus sign doing its work on two numbers
branches.cn: 一个加号在两个数上干活

branches.cn: 经营公交的公司印出的时刻表

intro.en: The word is the Latin verb for working plus the agent suffix -or, and the same stem then gives the act, the adjective and the symbol.
intro.cn: 这个词由拉丁语表示「干活」的动词加施事后缀 -or 构成；同一词干随后又给出行为、形容词和符号的说法。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is the agent noun of the working verb, so the word has meant one who works from the start.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词的拉丁语来源是「干活」动词的施事名词，所以它从一开始就是「干活的人」的意思。

items.meaning: a person who works a machine

latinEntries.meaning: to work, to produce an effect
